question: Cooking 1 flatbread takes 3 minutes, and the pan can cook 2 flatbreads at the same time. What is the minimum number of minutes needed to cook 2 flatbreads? Calculate: \(3+0=?\)
solution: Cooking both flatbreads at the same time takes only 3 minutes.
